row: 岡仁波齊位於西藏西部岡底斯山脈，海拔 6,638 公尺，被印度教、佛教、耆那教與苯教尊為聖山；禁止攀登。

airspace.zh: 前往岡仁波齊轉山需辦理旅行許可；本片為電腦擬真畫面，非實地空拍。
airspace.en: Pilgrims need a stamped travel permit for the Kailash kora. This film is simulated, not real drone footage.

southface.note: the face seen from Darchen (approximate point)

darchen.note: start and end of the kora

dolma.note: 5,630 m, highest point of the kora (approximate)

title.zh-Hant: 岡仁波齊：日照金山與風雪

tagline.zh-Hant: 日出把峰頂燒成金色，午後的暴風雪讓聖山換了臉
tagline.en: Sunrise turns the summit gold; an afternoon blizzard changes its face

zh: 黎明前的西藏西部，岡仁波齊仍在藍色的陰影裡。
海拔 6,638 公尺，屹立在岡底斯山脈。
en: Before dawn in western Tibet, Kailash still stands in blue shadow.
It rises to 6,638 m in the Gangdisê Range.

zh: 第一道陽光落在峰頂，雪面燒成金色。
下方的山谷，還要等好一陣子才見得到太陽。
en: The first sunlight lands on the summit and the snow turns gold.
The valleys below will wait a while longer for the sun.

zh: 這座山被印度教、佛教、耆那教與苯教共同尊崇。
中國政府禁止攀登，至今沒有登頂的紀錄。
en: Kailash is held sacred in Hinduism, Buddhism, Jainism and Bön.
Climbing is prohibited by the Chinese government; no ascent has been recorded.

zh: 南壁正中，一道垂直的冰雪溝槽從峰頂直落而下。
低角度的晨光，讓每一層岩階都拉出長長的影子。
en: A vertical gully of ice and snow drops straight down the middle of the south face.
Low morning light gives every rock band a long shadow.

zh: 山腳的塔爾欽，是轉山的起點與終點。
環繞岡仁波齊一圈約 52 公里，一般走三天。
en: Darchen, at the foot of the mountain, is where the kora begins and ends.
The circuit round Kailash is about 52 km and usually takes three days.

zh: 南方的瑪旁雍錯海拔約 4,600 公尺，是亞洲最高的淡水湖之一。
湖水經岡噶曲流入西邊的鹹水湖拉昂錯。
en: To the south, Lake Manasarovar lies at about 4,600 m, one of the highest freshwater lakes in Asia.
It overflows through the Ganga Chhu into the salt lake Rakshastal to the west.

zh: 湖的對岸，是 7,694 公尺的納木那尼峰。
1985 年，中日聯合登山隊經北壁首次登頂。
en: Across the lake stands Gurla Mandhata, 7,694 m.
A joint Sino-Japanese team first climbed it by the north face in 1985.

zh: 午後，西風把雲推上山脊。
峰頂開始冒出雪煙。
en: In the afternoon the west wind pushes cloud up the ridges.
Snow begins to stream off the summit.

zh: 風雪來得又快又急。
雪煙沿著稜線被扯成長長的旗幟。
en: The storm comes fast and hard.
Spindrift is torn from the ridge into long banners.

zh: 北側的山谷裡，轉山的路被雪掩去。
能見度只剩下兩、三公里。
en: In the valley on the north side, the kora path disappears under snow.
Visibility is down to two or three kilometres.

zh: 卓瑪拉山口海拔 5,630 公尺，是轉山的最高點。
在這樣的天氣，沒有人會停留。
en: Drölma La, at 5,630 m, is the highest point of the kora.
In weather like this, no one lingers.

zh: 傍晚，風暴越過山頭往東走。
雲海沉到腳下，只留下山峰在夕照裡。
en: By evening the storm has moved on to the east.
A sea of cloud settles below, leaving only the peaks in the low sun.

zh: 最後的光從西壁慢慢往上退。
印度河、薩特萊傑河、雅魯藏布江與格爾納利河都發源在這一帶。
en: The last light climbs slowly up the west face.
The Indus, Sutlej, Brahmaputra and Karnali all rise in this region.

zh: 夜色降臨，山峰的輪廓還亮著一點粉紅。
本片為擬真畫面：真實地形與衛星影像，光線依當天的日照計算。
en: Night falls; the outline of the peak keeps a little pink.
Simulated: real terrain and satellite imagery, with light from the sun position of that day.

sources.title: High altitude of Mount Kailash kora (Tibet Tour)
